title_working: The Boy Who Bought Broken Bike Wheels
world_rule: The Boy Who Bought Broken Bike Wheels

lines.text: Every Friday at three o'clock, Mason spends his entire allowance buying broken bike wheels from the school janitor.
lines.say: (serious) Every Friday at three o'clock, Mason spends his entire allowance buying broken bike wheels from the school janitor.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So the whole sixth grade laughed at him, especially Marcus, who mocked him daily for carrying greasy scrap metal.
lines.say: (angry) So the whole sixth grade laughed at him, especially Marcus, who mocked him daily for carrying greasy scrap metal.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But Mason never argued back; he simply tucked each bent rim into his heavy backpack and sketched notes in a blue pocketbook.
lines.say: (soft tone) But Mason never argued back; he simply tucked each bent rim into his heavy backpack and sketched notes in a blue pocketbook.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So whenever Marcus kicked an old dented gear down the hall, Mason quietly retrieved it and wiped off the dust.
lines.say: (sad) So whenever Marcus kicked an old dented gear down the hall, Mason quietly retrieved it and wiped off the dust.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But when the annual downhill derby arrived, Noel, the quietest boy in class who walked with leg braces, sat alone by the bleachers.
lines.say: (worried) But when the annual downhill derby arrived, Noel, the quietest boy in class who walked with leg braces, sat alone by the bleachers.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So Marcus announced across the entire hill that his store-bought kart had already won without any real challenger.
lines.say: (confident) So Marcus announced across the entire hill that his store-bought kart had already won without any real challenger.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But right before the starter raised the flag, Mason rolled onto the track pushing a shiny, hand-cranked speed cart.
lines.say: (serious) But right before the starter raised the flag, Mason rolled onto the track pushing a shiny, hand-cranked speed cart.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The truth was, Mason had spent three months rebuilding every piece of discarded metal to engineer a custom hand-pedal racer for Noel.
lines.say: (soft tone) The truth was, Mason had spent three months rebuilding every piece of discarded metal to engineer a custom hand-pedal racer for Noel.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So the whole crowd fell silent as Noel strapped himself into the padded seat and grabbed the twin steering levers.
lines.say: (nervous) So the whole crowd fell silent as Noel strapped himself into the padded seat and grabbed the twin steering levers.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So Noel cranked the rebuilt gears downhill and crossed the finish line first while Marcus froze in disbelief.
lines.say: (happy) So Noel cranked the rebuilt gears downhill and crossed the finish line first while Marcus froze in disbelief.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So nobody in the sixth grade ever makes fun of the boy with the rusty backpack again.
lines.say: (happy) So nobody in the sixth grade ever makes fun of the boy with the rusty backpack again.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Instead, everyone cheers when Friday hits at three o'clock, and Mason spends his entire allowance buying broken bike wheels from the school janitor.
lines.say: (confident) Instead, everyone cheers when Friday hits at three o'clock, and Mason spends his entire allowance buying broken bike wheels from the school janitor.
lines.speaker: narrator
